1. The revisionist has assailed framing of charge for offence under Section 376 IPC.

The learned senior counsel for the revisionist has taken me through the record, contending that the alleged incident occurred on 31.12.2022 and on the same day, on phone call of the prosecutrix, general diary entry was recorded by PS Dwarka Sector-23, which followed statement of the prosecutrix.
But in the said GD entry and her statement, the prosecutrix did not even whisper of any sexual assault or even misconduct.
In the said GD entry and her statement, the prosecutrix only alleged that she This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/07/2025 at 22:30:15 was assaulted by her in-laws, so she was taking away her child to her parental home.
It is only on 12.07.2023, that the prosecutrix lodged a complaint which led to registration of FIR No. 175/2023 of PS Dwarka for offence under Section 354/354A/354D/376/506/509/498A/406/34 IPC.

Learned senior counsel for the revisionist argues that this is a case of clear abuse of process by prosecutrix,
who is involved in matrimonial litigation with brother of the revisionist.
2. Learned APP accepts notice.

3.
